en: The mythical Supervoid... Its aura is far more oppressive than the Ruin's.
An orange planet associated with some kind of a Human celebration, I guess.
If you gaze into the abyss long enough, the abyss also gazes into you.
Exploring permafrost planets requires additional protection against low temperatures.
Volcanic planets may be hot but even they cannot compare to the extremes of a raging inferno.
The radiation of nuclear wastelands is so immense it can erode my vessel.
